Package io.openlineage.client.transports

Class HttpProxyConfig

java.lang.Object
io.openlineage.client.transports.HttpProxyConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
MergeConfig<HttpProxyConfig>
public final class HttpProxyConfig extends Object implements MergeConfig<HttpProxyConfig>
Explicit proxy configuration for the HTTP transport.

When this is set the transport will route all outgoing requests through the specified proxy. Alternatively, JVM system properties (-Dhttps.proxyHost / -Dhttps.proxyPort, or their http.* equivalents) can be used without any config change; explicit config takes precedence. 


 transport:
   type: http
   url: https://lineage-endpoint
   proxy:
     host: squid.internal
     port: 3128
